title: Hot Lava Bucket
description: Makes the player drop lava buckets from inventory.
body:
**Just a simple mod that aims to disable direct player manipulation of lava. Useful in modpacks where lava can cheese some challenges.**

Checks the player every tick for lava buckets, if one is found, it will drop the bucket, set the player on fire for 5 seconds and display "Ouch! This is very hot." on the action bar.
_(text is changed to "Ai! Isso está muito quente." if the language is Brazilian Portuguese)_

This won't work with modded buckets.
There are no plans to update this mod in the future. I just needed this for a personal modpack of mine and thought someone else might need it too.

_Made with MCreator_
